job.title: Electrical Superintendent
job.description:
Are you an experienced Electrical Superintendent or senior electrical leader looking for a unique international opportunity where you'll take responsibility for critical hydroelectric generation assets and a high-voltage transmission and distribution network?

We are seeking an Electrical Superintendent to lead the reliability, maintenance and continuous improvement of a complex electrical network supporting multiple hydro power stations, HV substations, transmission and distribution systems, industrial facilities and surrounding communities.
This is a senior expatriate opportunity with one of Papua New Guinea's most established and diversified organisations, combining hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for critical power infrastructure.
Working across a geographically dispersed network, you'll lead electrical maintenance and reliability activities to ensure the safe, reliable and efficient operation of hydroelectric generation assets and the associated HV transmission and distribution systems.

What's on Offer
  • Salary up to AUD $250,000
    Comprehensive expatriate package
  • Company-provided accommodation
  • Full relocation assistance
  • Annual leave and return flights
  • Comprehensive medical insurance
  • Company vehicle
  • Long-term international career opportunity
  • Live and work in one of Papua New Guinea's most spectacular regions, surrounded by mountains, rainforest and outdoor adventure
About the Role
Reporting to the Engineering Manager, the Electrical Superintendent will provide operational and technical leadership across hydro power generation and the HV transmission and distribution network, with responsibility for electrical maintenance, system reliability, asset performance and safety.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading electrical maintenance and reliability across multiple hydroelectric power stations and associated HV infrastructure
  • Managing and developing electrical engineering, maintenance and technical teams
  • Overseeing HV substations, transformers, switchgear and transmission and distribution networks
  • Managing protection systems, relays, circuit breakers and electrical network integrity
  • Developing preventative and predictive maintenance strategies
  • Leading fault finding, root cause analysis and power system investigations
  • Planning and coordinating shutdowns, outages and major maintenance programs
  • Managing capital projects, electrical upgrades and network improvements
  • Overseeing protection coordination, testing and commissioning activities
  • Managing contractors and specialist service providers
  • Driving continuous improvement in electrical reliability and asset performance
  • Ensuring compliance with electrical, safety and environmental standards
  • Working closely with operations to maximise generation availability and network reliability
You'll Ideally Bring
  • Degree or relevant tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering, OR trade qualification + relevant experience
  • Significant experience in HV transmission and distribution, power generation, utilities, mining or heavy industrial environments
  • Previous experience in an Electrical Superintendent, Electrical Manager, Maintenance Superintendent or senior electrical leadership role
  • Strong knowledge of HV substations, transformers, switchgear, protection relays and electrical distribution systems
  • Experience with power system protection, network reliability and electrical asset management
  • Demonstrated experience leading electrical maintenance and technical teams
  • Strong troubleshooting, fault-finding and continuous improvement capability
  • Experience managing shutdowns, electrical projects, contractors and capital works
  • Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Hydro generation experience is advantageous, but strong transmission and distribution experience is the priority
  • Previous remote, regional or expatriate experience will be highly regarded
This is far more than a traditional electrical engineering position.

As Electrical Superintendent, you'll have genuine ownership of critical electrical infrastructure, leading the people, maintenance strategies and technical improvements required to maximise reliability across both hydro generation and HV transmission and distribution assets.

With a salary of up to AUD $250,000 plus a comprehensive expatriate package, this represents an outstanding opportunity for an experienced electrical leader looking to take on significant technical responsibility while building an international career.

If you have strong HV transmission, distribution, protection and electrical maintenance leadership experience, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact RobLawMax Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Automotive Electrician
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Auto Electrician to join our established mining operation in regional New South Wales.
This is an excellent opportunity to build a stable career in a well-supported environment, working on essential heavy mobile equipment.
As part of a skilled maintenance team, you’ll contribute directly to equipment reliability and mine productivity — all while enjoying the benefit of being home every night.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform electrical servicing, diagnostics, repairs, and maintenance on a wide range of heavy mobile equipment.
  • Specialise in underground mining fleets and auxiliary equipment in both underground and workshop environments
  • Carry out advanced electrical troubleshooting, fault finding, and diagnostic scanning to minimise downtime.
  • Conduct scheduled preventative maintenance on electrical systems and respond to breakdowns as needed.
  • Install, commission, and maintain vehicle control systems, communication gear, and air conditioning systems.
  • Work safely and ensure all tasks align with site safety and environmental standards.
  • Work closely with supervisors, planners, and fellow trades to support efficient operations. 
To Be Successful, You Will Have:
  • A recognised trade qualification – Automotive Electrician (Cert III in Automotive Electrical Technology or equivalent).
  • Proven experience working within underground mining environments or on underground mobile plant equipment.
  • Strong diagnostic and fault-finding capability across major underground fleets, including Sandvik, Epiroc, CAT, Volvo, and Normet.
  • Solid understanding of low-voltage electrical systems, CAN-bus networks, and auto-air conditioning.
  • Commitment to safe work practices and compliance with site procedures.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team. 
What’s on Offer
  • Competitive hourly rates and excellent earning potential
  • Genuine long-term career stability with opportunities for professional development
  • Permanent full-time residential role — home every night on a 7/7 roster
  • Well-equipped workshop and support from experienced supervisors
  • Work with a respected, stable mining company committed to growth and safety
For any questions please reach out to Ashah Miller on 0405 611 596 or email on ashahm@roblawmax.com.au

job.title: Sawmill Superintendent
job.description:
The Opportunity
Are you an experienced Sawmill Superintendent or Production Manager looking for an opportunity to take ownership of a substantial timber manufacturing operation?
 
We are seeking an experienced Sawmill Superintendent to join one of Papua New Guinea's most established manufacturing organisations, based in Bulolo, Morobe Province.
 
Offering a salary up to $180,000 AUD plus a comprehensive expatriate package, this is a senior, hands-on operational leadership position with responsibility across the company's sawmill, planing mill, timber treatment facilities and kilns.
 
The successful candidate will lead production teams, drive consistent quality and output, develop local capability and ensure operations are delivered safely and efficiently.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead sawmill, planing mill, treatment plant and kiln operations
  • Manage production teams to achieve quality, output and delivery targets
  • Provide strong, disciplined and visible leadership across the operation
  • Manage production processes, materials and stock movements
  • Ensure finished timber products meet required quality standards
  • Manage consumables including saw blades, planer knives, treatment chemicals, packing and strapping materials
  • Monitor operational equipment across the sawmill and planing mill
  • Drive workplace safety and compliance
  • Provide hands-on training, mentoring and development of employees
  • Identify and implement operational and workplace improvements
  • Work collaboratively as part of the company's senior management team
About You
We are looking for someone who has built their career within sawmilling and timber processing and understands the practical realities of running a productive manufacturing operation.
 
You will ideally bring:
  • Significant experience within the sawmill and timber industry
  • At least 5 years' experience at a senior operational or supervisory level
  • Strong knowledge of sawmill and planing mill operations
  • Experience with timber treatment plants and kiln operations
  • Demonstrated production and people-management capability
  • Strong workplace health and safety knowledge
  • Experience improving production processes, quality and operational performance
  • The ability to train, mentor and develop employees
  • A practical, hands-on leadership style
  • The ability to manage multiple production priorities in a demanding environment
Previous experience working in a remote, regional or developing-country environment would be advantageous but is not essential.
 
The successful candidate will receive up to $180,000 AUD salary + comprehensive expatriate benefits The expatriate package includes relocation and associated benefits to support living and working in Papua New Guinea.
 
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced sawmilling professional who enjoys being close to the operation and wants genuine ownership of production, people, quality and performance.
 
Apply now for a confidential discussion about the position, organisation and expatriate package.

job.title: Graduate Surveyor
job.description:
Are you a recent graduate or nearing the end of your surveying studies?

We are seeking a motivated Graduate Surveyor to join a growing team in a permanent position. With a large number of projects underway and a strong pipeline, this role offers long-term stability, exceptional hands-on training, and rapid career progression.
In this role, you won't just be stuck doing one thing. You will gain invaluable exposure to civil and structural engineering infrastructure.
It will be a structured environment designed to build your confidence, offering a dynamic mix of field data collection and office-based data management.

Why Join Us?
  • Permanent full-time role with a predictable, lifestyle-friendly Monday – Friday roster
  • Exposure to working alongside experienced Senior Surveyors and Managers
  • Local residential option – perfect if you want to be home every night
  • Competitive graduate salary package
  • Access to modern surveying equipment and industry-leading software (GPS, Total Stations, 12d, etc.)
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment with clear career development paths
About the Role
Working alongside our Senior team, you will be given the tools and guidance to gradually take ownership of survey activities across multiple civil and structural engineering sites.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Assisting with precise construction and engineering set-out programs for civil and structural assets
  • Learning to manage your own workflow seamlessly between field data capture and office processing/reporting
  • Learning to review and validate accurate detail, feature, and topographic surveys
  • Contributing to detailed as-built surveys, volume calculations, and comprehensive reporting
  • Developing technical expertise on complex structural and civil infrastructure components
  • Gaining high proficiency in the accurate use and calibration of GNSS, total stations, and cutting-edge survey instruments
  • Maintaining strict survey accuracy, data quality assurance, and safety standards 
About You
We are looking for an enthusiastic, proactive individual who is eager to learn, ask questions, and eventually work independently both on-site and in the office.
You will ideally have:
  • A Degree or Advanced Diploma in Surveying (or currently completing your final year)
  • A strong interest in Engineering, Civil, and Structural surveying
  • A desire to develop autonomy and manage field-to-office deliverables efficiently
  • Basic exposure to or a keen willingness to learn modern surveying instruments and processing software (such as 12d, Civil3D, Trimble, or Leica)
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality data
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • A current, valid Australian driver’s licence
For any further questions please reach out to Ashah Miller on 0405 611 596 or email on ashahm@roblawmax.com.au

  • Local residential option – perfect if you want to be home every night
  • Competitive salary package tailored to your experience

  • Strong attention to detail and a steadfast commitment to high-quality data
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills

For any further questions please reach out to Ashah Miller on 0405 611 596 or email on ashahm@roblawmax.com.au
